metadata.description: 626 Labs plugins: the design system + publishing umbrella (626labs), the Lab dashboard connection (626labs-lab), and two Claude Code mods (now-playing, agent-comms).

plugins.name: 626labs
plugins.description: 626 Labs design system + publishing umbrella. Two slash-invocable skills: /626labs:design (brand, tokens, UI kit, editorial layer) and /626labs:publishing (studios/works/library/packages router).

plugins.name: 626labs-lab
plugins.description: Connect Claude Code to The Lab (626 Labs dashboard) over OAuth: projects, tasks, decisions, deployments and IDE control as MCP tools, plus a skill for repo binding, task briefs and decision logging. Sign in once with /mcp.

plugins.name: now-playing
plugins.description: A live now-playing band above the prompt, read from the Windows media session (YouTube Music in Chrome included): artist and title in a per-song letter style and gradient, a glowing progress bar, synced lyrics from LRCLIB, and play/pause/next/prev with /np. Windows only.

plugins.name: agent-comms
plugins.description: A band above the prompt listing every message to another agent still waiting on a reply, with a running clock and a toast when the reply lands. Tracks subagents and SendMessage; add MCP tools that ask other agents with the agentTools option.
